title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts — Exit Cashback Cap Schedule by Shopper Level and Recent Base Pay
content:
**Schedule note — Everyday Pay Card exit settlements under Cartwise Shopper Payouts.** When an account moves off the Everyday Pay Card plans, the cap under which the settlement's statement month is held (the exit cap) depends on the shopper's level and recent work: a shopper at Full-Service Shopper Platinum or Diamond level with 10 or more batch base-pay entries in the last month is settled under 1.5 times the monthly cashback cap of the plan being left; a shopper at Full-Service Shopper Gold level with 8 or more batch base-pay entries in the last month is settled under 1.25 times that cap; any other shopper is settled under the monthly cashback cap of the plan being left; a raised cap is rounded to the cent.

**Records read.** The shopper level is the level on the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record. The base-pay entries are the batch pay entries for base pay posted on the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Batches records. "The last month" counts the entries booked fewer than 1 whole month before the day of the move. Shopper levels rank upward in the order Shop-Only Shopper, Full-Service Shopper, Full-Service Shopper Silver, Full-Service Shopper Gold, Full-Service Shopper Platinum and Full-Service Shopper Diamond.

| Shopper level | Base-pay entries in the last month | Exit cap |
|---|---|---|
| Full-Service Shopper Platinum or Diamond | 10 or more | 1.5 times the plan's monthly cashback cap, rounded to the cent |
| Full-Service Shopper Platinum or Diamond | 9 or fewer | the plan's monthly cashback cap |
| Full-Service Shopper Gold | 8 or more | 1.25 times the plan's monthly cashback cap, rounded to the cent |
| Full-Service Shopper Gold | 7 or fewer | the plan's monthly cashback cap |
| Full-Service Shopper Silver or below | any number | the plan's monthly cashback cap |

"The plan's monthly cashback cap" is the monthly cashback cap of the card plan being left.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical inputs, cap of the plan being left taken as 33.00)

- Full-Service Shopper Diamond, exactly 10 base-pay entries: 1.5 times 33.00 is 49.50.
- Full-Service Shopper Platinum, 9 base-pay entries: 33.00, no raise.
- Full-Service Shopper Gold, exactly 8 base-pay entries: 1.25 times 33.00 is 41.25.
- Full-Service Shopper Gold, 7 base-pay entries: 33.00, no raise.
- Full-Service Shopper Silver, 40 base-pay entries: 33.00 — the level does not reach Gold, so the count does not raise the cap.
